text.Infested Moon:
How to play ==
At any time during your turn, gain 4 Combat. If you have another Blob card in play, you may draw a card. If you have two (or more) other Blob cards in play, you may draw another card. 
 Strategy ==
This card is extremely strong in a Blob-rich deck. With two other Blob cards in play, you can draw two additional cards. Infested Moon is the only base in the entire Frontier set that can draw two cards. It is especially deadly when you have multiple Blob bases in play, since the draw then triggers automatically and does not require the luck that you draw Blob cards in your next hand. If you acquire this card, it is often useful to buy other Blob bases to make it more likely that its ally abilities are triggered. Because it is so dangerous, opponents often make it their prime target to take out. If there are not outposts to protect it this is not so hard since the defense is 5, but if it is protected by one or more outposts and sticks around for a few turns this base can really be a game changer. 

In a deck without Blob cards to trigger the draws, it is nowhere near as deadly, but can still be a fair buy for 6 trade.
